name: Pumpradar VolumeKing

changelog.description: Initial production deployment — exact v0.1 baseline

backtest_180d.note: profitable baseline +9.1%. Volume-only signal (vol=3, candle=1) with strict 2.5x threshold.

changelog.description: Lowered vol threshold 2.5→2.0, reduced vol weight 3.0→2.5, added MACD=0.5 and pressure=0.5

backtest_180d.note: adding MACD+pressure+lowering vol threshold turned +9.1% to -20.5%. Lower threshold 2.5→2.0 alone allows ~40% more volume events, diluting the spike-quality filter.

changelog.description: ROLLBACK — reverted to v0.1 params (vol_threshold=2.5, vol_weight=3.0, no macd, no pressure, no threshold override). v0.2 regression -29.6pp. Pure volume spike strategy works precisely because it only fires on genuine unusual volume events.

backtest_180d.note: identical to v0.1 params — expect similar to v0.1 +9.1%

description: Volume-first thesis: 3x volume weight, trend + candle for confirmation, everything else muted
